text_ja: 前項の規定にかかわらず、TLAC規制対象最終指定親会社については、第二条の二第一項の算式における資本バッファーに係る普通株式等Tier1資本の額は、第一号に掲げる額から第二号に掲げる額を控除した額とする。ただし、第三条の規定にかかわらず、第二号に掲げる額の算出に当たっては、最終指定親会社TLAC告示第一条第九号に規定する国内処理対象最終指定親会社グループに含まれる子法人等に限り、連結の範囲に含めるものとする。一前項第一号に掲げる額から前項第二号及び第三号に掲げる額を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)二リスク・アセットの額に最低所要リスク・アセットベースTLAC比率(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第一条第十号に規定する最低所要リスク・アセットベースTLAC比率をいう。)から八パーセント(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第二条第二項の規定を適用する場合にあっては、十一・五パーセント)を控除して得た比率を乗じて得た額から次に掲げる額の合計額を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)イその他外部TLAC調達手段の額(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第四条第一項第九号に掲げる額から同条第二項第四号及び第五号に掲げる額の合計額を控除した額をいう。)ロその他Tier1資本の額(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第四条第一項第二号から第四号までに掲げる額の合計額から同条第二項第二号に掲げる額を控除した額をいう。(2)において同じ。)から次に掲げる額の合計額を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)(１)リスク・アセットの額に一・五パーセントを乗じて得た額(２)その他Tier1資本の額がリスク・アセットの額に一・五パーセントを乗じて得た額を上回る場合にあっては、リスク・アセットの額に二パーセントを乗じて得た額からTier2資本の額(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第四条第一項第五号から第八号までに掲げる額の合計額から同条第二項第三号に掲げる額を控除した額をいう。ハにおいて同じ。)を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)ハTier2資本の額からリスク・アセットの額に二パーセントを乗じて得た額を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)
text_en: Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, with respect to TLAC-regulated Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, the amount of Common Equity Tier 1 Capital relating to the capital buffer in the formula of Article 2-2, paragraph (1) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in item (ii) from the amount set forth in item (i); provided, however, that notwithstanding Article 3, in calculating the amount set forth in item (ii), only subsidiaries included in the domestic resolution Ultimate Designated Parent Company group as provided in Article 1, item (ix) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies shall be included in the scope of consolidation. (i) The amount obtained by deducting the amounts set forth in items (ii) and (iii) of the preceding paragraph from the amount set forth in item (i) of the preceding paragraph (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (ii) The amount obtained by deducting the sum of the following amounts from the amount obtained by multiplying the risk-weighted assets amount by the ratio obtained by deducting 8% (11.5% in cases where the provisions of Article 2, paragraph (2) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies apply) from the minimum required risk-weighted assets-based TLAC ratio (meaning the minimum required risk-weighted assets-based TLAC ratio as provided in Article 1, item (x) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (a) The amount of other external TLAC instruments (meaning the amount obtained by deducting the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 4, paragraph (2), items (iv) and (v) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies from the amount set forth in Article 4, paragraph (1), item (ix) of such Public Notice). (b) The amount obtained by deducting the sum of the following amounts from the amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital (meaning the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in Article 4, paragraph (2), item (ii) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies from the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 4, paragraph (1), items (ii) through (iv) of such Public Notice; the same applies in (2)) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (1) The amount obtained by multiplying the risk-weighted assets amount by 1.5%. (2) In cases where the amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital exceeds the amount obtained by multiplying the risk-weighted assets amount by 1.5%, the amount obtained by deducting the amount of Tier 2 Capital (meaning the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in Article 4, paragraph (2), item (iii) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies from the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 4, paragraph (1), items (v) through (viii) of such Public Notice; the same applies in (c)) from the amount obtained by multiplying the risk-weighted assets amount by 2% (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (c) The amount obtained by deducting from the amount of Tier 2 Capital the amount obtained by multiplying the risk-weighted assets amount by 2% (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero).
